prompt: TicketReader is package-private, TurnstileGate is the public face of the package. Finish TurnstileGate so it delegates to its private reader. Complete the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: A type or member with no access modifier at all is package-private: reachable from any class in the same package and from nowhere else. That makes TicketReader a helper the package can collaborate with freely while the outside world only ever sees TurnstileGate's public methods. Holding the reader in a private final field means the gate can be rewritten to use a different reader without breaking a single caller.
hints: addTicket does not need any logic of its own -- hand the code straight to reader.load, which already ignores null and empty codes.
scan must ask reader.accepts first and only increment admitted when the answer is true.
ticketCount just forwards to reader.size(); the gate never needs to keep a second copy of the codes.
